get.propertyName: Must be a valid ScriptSlider property

set.propertyName: Must be a valid ScriptSlider property

setConsumedKeyPresses.listOfKeys: Supports special values and KeyPress descriptors

setControlCallback.controlFunction: Must be inline and take exactly 2 parameters

setMode.mode: Must match one of the valid mode strings

setPropertiesFromJSON.jsonData: Keys must be valid ScriptSlider property names

setRange.min: Must be < max for usable range
setRange.max: Must be > min for usable range

setStyle.style: Must match one of the valid style names

setStyleSheetPseudoState.pseudoState: Use valid pseudo-state tokens or empty string

get.propertyName: Must be a valid ScriptSliderPack property

set.propertyName: Must be a valid ScriptSliderPack property

setAllValues.value: Buffer / Array values beyond slider count are ignored

setAllValuesWithUndo.value: Buffer / Array values are copied into an undo action

setConsumedKeyPresses.listOfKeys: Must be valid JUCE key descriptions

setControlCallback.controlFunction: Must be inline and accept exactly 2 args

setKeyPressCallback.keyboardFunction: Must be inline and consume one event object

setStyleSheetClass.classIds: Component type class is prepended automatically

setMouseHandlingProperties.propertyObject: Uses known property keys listed below

bindCallback.callbackId: Must be unique across all bound callbacks

callFunction.javascriptFunction: Must exist in the webview's global JS scope
callFunction.args: Any type; passed as-is to JS

evaluate.identifier: Should be unique per logical evaluation; reusing a key overwrites the previous code

get.propertyName: Must be a valid property ID for ScriptWebView

sendToWebSocket.data: Must be String, Buffer, or JSON Object

set.propertyName: Must be a valid property ID for ScriptWebView
set.value: Type must match the property's expected type

setControlCallback.controlFunction: Must be an inline function with exactly 2 parameters

setEnableWebSocket.port: Use -1 for a random available port

setIndexFile.indexFile: Must be a File object (from FileSystem API)

setStyleSheetProperty.value: Type must match the conversion specified by the type parameter

setStyleSheetPseudoState.pseudoState: Can combine multiple states; pass "" to clear

setZLevel.zLevel: Must be one of the four valid values (case-sensitive)

updateBuffer.bufferIndex: Must match an index used in addBufferToWebSocket

downloadFile.targetFile: Must be a File object, not a directory
downloadFile.callback: Must accept 0 arguments; `this` is the Download object

setBaseURL.url: Should be a valid HTTP/HTTPS URL

isMidiInputEnabled.midiInputName: Must match an available device name

setAudioDevice.name: Must match an available device name

setAudioDeviceType.deviceName: Must match an available device type

setBufferSize.newBlockSize: Should match an available buffer size

setOutputChannel.index: Must be a valid pair index

setSampleFolder.sampleFolder: Must be a File object pointing to an existing directory

setSampleRate.sampleRate: Should match an available sample rate

stopPerfettoTracing.traceFileToUse: Must be a File with `.pftrace` extension

toggleMidiInput.midiInputName: Must match an available device name

getSliderPack.sliderPackIndex: >= 0, must be less than the number of slider packs owned by the module

setEffect.effectName: Valid effect type name or network ID

swap.otherSlot: Must be a valid SlotFX object in HotswappableProcessor mode

split.separator: Only the first character is used

addEffect.type: Must be a valid factory type
addEffect.id: If an existing effect has this ID, it is returned

addMessageFromHolder.messageHolder: Must be a valid MessageHolder, not empty

addModulator.type: Must be a valid factory type for the target chain

attachNote.artificialNoteId: Must be an artificial event ID

getIdList.type: Must match the processor's getName() string exactly

getMidiProcessor.name: Must match exactly; cannot be the current script processor's own ID

noteOffByEventId.eventId: > 0; must refer to an artificial event

setAttribute.newAttribute: Range depends on the specific parameter

setModulatorAttribute.newValue: Range depends on parameter; Intensity: 0.0-1.0 for gain, -12.0 to 12.0 semitones for pitch

setVoiceGainValue.voiceIndex: >= 0 (negative values clamped to 0); must be < voice count

setVoicePitchValue.voiceIndex: >= 0 (negative values clamped to 0); must be < voice count

setTablePointsFromArray.pointList: Min 2 sub-arrays, each with exactly 3 elements

tryLoad.returnValueIfLocked: Should match the expected data type

setEnableGrid.tempoFactor: 0-18 (see table below). Reports script error if out of range.

setLocalGridMultiplier.factor: Must be 1 or a power of two (2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64). Reports script error if not. Clamped to [1, 64].

setOnBeatChange.f: Must be `inline function` if sync is `SyncNotification`. Must accept 2 parameters.

setOnGridChange.f: Must be `inline function` if sync is `SyncNotification`. Must accept 3 parameters.

setOnSignatureChange.f: Must be `inline function` if sync is `SyncNotification`. Must accept 2 parameters.

setOnTempoChange.f: Must be `inline function` if sync is `SyncNotification`. Must accept 1 parameter.

setOnTransportChange.f: Must be `inline function` if sync is `SyncNotification`. Must accept 1 parameter.

isValidKeyFile.possibleKeyData: Must start with `"Keyfile for "` to pass

setProductCheckFunction.checkFunction: Must accept 1 argument, must return bool

writeKeyFile.keyData: Should start with `"Keyfile for "` for validity

copyTo.target: Must match stack mode for Buffer/Stack targets

setIsEventStack.eventCompareFunction: Constants: 0-4; or inline function with 2 params

attachAutomationCallback.automationId: Must match a registered automation ID

getAutomationIndex.automationID: Must match an ID registered via `setCustomAutomation`

sendParameterGesture.indexWithinType: Must be a valid index for the given type

setCustomAutomation.automationData: Must be an Array; each element must be a JSON object with at least `ID` and `connections`

setEnableUserPresetPreprocessing.shouldUnpackComplexData: Boolean value; only meaningful when processBeforeLoading is true

setPluginParameterGroupNames.pluginParameterGroupNames: Must be an Array; throws a script error if not

setPluginParameterSortFunction.customSortFunction: Must accept 2 arguments when a function; must return Integer

setUseCustomUserPresetModel.loadCallback: Must be a JavaScript function; must accept 1 argument
setUseCustomUserPresetModel.saveCallback: Must be a JavaScript function; must accept 1 argument

updateAutomationValues.data: Integer or Array; passing a single JSON object throws a script error

updateSaveInPresetComponents.obj: Must be a valid JSON object with the structure produced by `createObjectForSaveInPresetComponents`

setEnableResynthesisCache.cacheDirectory: Must be a valid directory path

setPostFXProcessors.postFXData: Each element must be a JSON object with a Type property

setResynthesisOptions.optionData: See Callback Properties for valid keys
